ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: An untarnished brilliance~!<CR>Deep in my soul~!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Незапятнанный блеск~!<CR>Глубоко в моей душе~!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hello, Hagel! Hahaha, singing again today?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Здравствуйте, Хагель! Ха-ха-ха, сегодня снова поёте?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hey, girls. Haha, I'm always singing!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Привет, девочки. Ха-ха, я всегда пою!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Singing with feeling makes work go more smoothly. More than that...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Пение с чувством делает работу проще. Более того...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: It would be a waste to not let my customers hear my lovely voice!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Было бы расточительством не дать покупателям услышать мой прекрасный голос!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hah, "waste" isn't the word I'd use!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ха, «расточительство» — не то слово, которое я бы выбрала!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Bah! You have no clue about art, Sue! No clue at all!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Пф! Ты ничего не смыслишь в искусстве, Сью! Совсем ничего!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Enough about this, anyway. What can I do for you today?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ладно, хватит об этом. Чем могу помочь сегодня?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Ah, well. We have a knife with a nick on it...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ах, ну... У нас нож с зазубриной...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: We found some uni but they are super tough. I took a mighty swing and it was the knife that lost...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Мы нашли уни, но они жутко твёрдые. Я сильно замахнулась — и нож проиграл...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Of course it did! A cooking knife isn't a weapon! Gah, like this is the first time...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ещё бы! Кухонный нож — не оружие! Ах, будто в первый раз...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hahaha... You've repaired not only our knives but also our pots and even our cauldron many times!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Вы ведь не раз чинили не только наши ножи, но и кастрюли, и даже котёл!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Good point. Thinking about it, almost all the metal stuff in our house was made by you, Hagel.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Верно. Если подумать, почти весь металл в нашем доме сделали вы, Хагель.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hahaha, you bet it is! Breaking things is what you do best, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, ещё бы! Ломать вещи — ваше лучшее умение, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Leave it to me, anyway. I'll have that knife as good as new, before you know it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Оставьте это мне. Нож будет как новенький, и глазом не моргнёте!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Great! Thanks so much, Hagel!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Отлично! Большое спасибо, Хагель!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: No problem! Now, in exchange for this, maybe...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Без проблем! А в обмен, может...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Could I add a function to your cauldron? Press a button and the flame color changes...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Добавить функцию к вашему котлу? Нажал кнопку — и цвет пламени меняется...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: That sounds completely pointless. No thanks. Please just repair the knife.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Звучит совершенно бессмысленно. Нет, спасибо. Просто почините нож, пожалуйста.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Gah, you guys are no fun... Alright, I'll take care of the knife, as boring as that is.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Эх, вы скучные... Ладно, займусь ножом, как бы ни было нудно.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Hey, girls. There's a little something I want to ask of you.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Эй, девочки. Хочу вас кое о чём попросить.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: That's right! I need you to fetch me some real quality ground metal!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Верно! Мне нужно, чтобы вы принесли качественный измельчённый металл!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Ground metal? That's it? Any particular reason why you are asking this of us?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Измельчённый металл? И всё? Есть особая причина, почему просите именно нас?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: I'm recalling something about a pot with two bottoms and a endlessly spinning doorknob... We really don't need that.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Вспоминается горшок с двумя донышками и вечно крутящаяся дверная ручка... Нам это совсем не нужно.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Those are just silly ideas I came up with when drinking with Roger.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Это просто глупые идеи, что пришли в голову, когда пили с Роджером.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: This time I'm making something much more serious, don't worry!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: На этот раз делаю куда более серьёзную вещь, не волнуйтесь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Alright... Then you won't mind telling us what it is you're making?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Хорошо... Тогда вы не против рассказать, что именно делаете?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: You aren't serious at all! You're planning on making something totally weird again!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Вы совсем несерьёзны! Снова замышляете что-то совершенно странное!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: No, I'm not. I'll pay you, so please just do the job!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Нет. Я заплачу, так что просто сделайте работу!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Alright, okay. I'm not really trusting this, but work is work.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Ладно, ладно. Я не особо доверяю, но работа есть работа.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Ah, that's just what I needed! Some fine, fine ground metal. Great work, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ах, именно то, что нужно! Отличный, отличный измельчённый металл. Отличная работа, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: I can make something really great with this. I can't wait to get started!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Из этого можно сделать кое-что по-настоящему великолепное. Не терпится начать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: In that case, I think we'll stay and watch. I'm still worried about what you're going to make...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Тогда мы, пожалуй, останемся и посмотрим. Всё ещё волнуюсь, что вы собираетесь сделать...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Yeah, good point. We'd better keep an eye on him.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Да, верно. Лучше присмотреть за вами.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: I don't mind an audience, but being stared at that hard makes me really uncomfortable.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Публика мне не мешает, но от такого пристального взгляда мне реально неловко.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Good, it's done!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Готово!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: ...what is that.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: ...что это.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: ...statue of a man with a shiny head?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: ...статуя мужчины с блестящей головой?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: YOU! Who are you calling bald?!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: ТЫ! Кого ты называешь лысым?!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Uwah! No one said bald!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ух! Никто не говорил «лысый»!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: You just said it, you little...!!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ты только что сказала, мелкая...!!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Uwaaah! That's not fair!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: А-а-а! Это нечестно!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Hold on, Hagel... Is this you?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Погодите, Хагель... Это вы?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Yes, that's right! Well done, Sue. Nice that you at least understand art!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Да, верно! Молодец, Сью. Приятно, что хоть ты смыслишь в искусстве!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Didn't you say she had no clue when we were here before?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: А разве вы не говорили, что я ничего не смыслю, когда мы были здесь раньше?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Let me level with you. As part of promoting my store I've been placing statues of myself around.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Скажу прямо. Для рекламы магазина я расставляю по округе свои статуи.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: They've become a bit too popular, though. Statues of the God of the Forge, they call them.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Но они стали слишком популярны. Их зовут статуями Бога Кузницы.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Huh... Because it looks a bit divine?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: А... Потому что выглядит немного божественно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Who's head looks pristinely divine?! Huh?!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Чья голова выглядит первозданно божественно?! А?!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Uwah! I can't say anything, can I?!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ух! Мне вообще ничего нельзя сказать?!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: I don't mind a bit of fame, but it has its downsides too. You can't be too careful.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Я не против славы, но у неё есть и минусы. Осторожность не помешает.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: So I decided to try a smaller size. That is what you see before you now, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Поэтому решил попробовать размер поменьше. Вот что вы сейчас видите, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Okay. This sounds about as totally ridiculous as I was expecting, but very well. What is this for?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ладно. Звучит примерно так же нелепо, как я и ожидала, но хорошо. Для чего это?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Decoration, of course! The bedroom. The living room. It will brighten any space where you place it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Для украшения, конечно! Спальня. Гостиная. Освежит любое место, куда поставите!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Brighten? More like intimidate...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Освежит? Скорее устрашит...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Hahaha, that's fine too! That just makes it more worthy of being displayed!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха, так даже лучше! Тем почётнее будет выставить это на всеобщее обозрение!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Right. As a reward, this one is for you.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Так. В награду — вот эта вам.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: What? W-We don't need that...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Что? Н-нам это не нужно...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Huuuh?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Эээ?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: W-Wow! What a lovely gift, thank you so much!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: О-ого! Какой чудесный подарок, огромное спасибо!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: W-What should we do with this? A paperweight? A doorstop, maybe?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ч-что нам теперь с этим делать? Использовать как груз для бумаг? Или подпереть им дверь?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Toss it in the cauldron and see what happens... That sounds like the best idea.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Бросить в котёл и посмотреть, что будет... Кажется, лучшая идея.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: <CLEG>Small Statue of Hagel<CLNR> was forced upon you...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Вам навязали <CLEG>Маленькую статую Хагеля<CLNR>...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Hey, Pamela. It's rare to see you here.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Привет, Памела. Тебя здесь редко увидишь.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I guess it is! Sorry, but the doorknob to my room broke...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Пожалуй, да! Извини, у меня сломалась дверная ручка в комнате...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I don't have to get it fixed, of course, but it is a bit of a bother.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Чинить, конечно, не обязательно, но это немного мешает.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Grace told me you're good at your job, so I came to see if you can help me!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Грейс сказала, что ты хорош в своём деле, вот я и пришла узнать, сможешь ли помочь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I see, I see. That sounds like something I can handle... hold on!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Понятно, понятно. С таким справлюсь... погоди!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I was thinking the same thing! I just can't remember where it was?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Я о том же думала! Просто не могу вспомнить, где?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Me either. The south? The west? Or could it be...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Я тоже. Юг? Запад? Или может...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Hmm, this is so annoying! Like an itch I can't scratch!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Хм, так раздражает! Как зуд, который не почешешь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: It can't be helped if we both don't remember. Pamela, was it?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Ничего не поделаешь, раз оба не помним. Памела, так?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: How about sharing a meal some time? I think we'd get along pretty well!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Как насчёт как-нибудь вместе пообедать? Думаю, мы бы неплохо поладили!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Oh my, that sounds lovely! I'll definitely take you up on that offer!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: О боже, звучит чудесно! Обязательно воспользуюсь предложением!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: That settles it! Ah, now about this troublesome doorknob...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Решено! Ах, теперь об этой злополучной дверной ручке...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: W-Wow, the two of them are getting along like a house on fire!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: О-ого, они вдвоём ладят как в горящем доме!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Hahaha! Like two weird little peas in a pod!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Как две странные горошины в одном стручке!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Hey, girls. I've got another request for you!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Эй, девочки. У меня к вам ещё одна просьба!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Yes? What is it this time?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Well, I want some thread. As delicate as you can find, smooth, and in bulk! Lots and lots of it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ну, нужны нити. Как можно тоньше, гладкие и много! Очень-очень много!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Lots of thread? What are you planning this time?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Много нитей? Что вы задумали на этот раз?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: I can't tell you! Torture me with my own forge implements, I won't tell!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Не скажу! Хоть пытайте меня моими же кузнечными инструментами — не скажу!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: It's something strange again, isn't it? The Hagel Toothbrush? The Hagel Towel?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Опять что-то странное, да? Зубная щётка Хагеля? Полотенце Хагеля?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Nothing like that! This time I'm aiming for something more...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ничего подобного! На этот раз я целюсь во что-то более...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Hah! I'm not falling for that, either! This one is top secret!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ха! На это тоже не куплюсь! Это совершенно секретно!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: You'll need to try harder than that to trick me! Now go and get to work, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Придётся постараться сильнее, чтобы меня обмануть! А теперь за работу, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Uwah, fine, fine. It's just going to be more worthless junk this time, though, isn't it?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ух, ладно, ладно. Но на этот раз это снова бесполезный хлам, да?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hagel. We've got the thread that you wanted...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Хагель. Мы принесли нити, которые вы просили...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Uwah! I literally only said your name!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ух! Я буквально сказала только ваше имя!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Ah! Sorry, little lady. I'm getting pretty nervous, for lots of reasons.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ах! Прости, малышка. Я очень нервничаю по куче причин.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Huh? Anyway, please accept this delivery.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: А? В общем, пожалуйста, примите доставку.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hey, this is good! Smooth as a maiden's hair, with great color and luster too!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Эй, отлично! Гладкие как девичьи волосы, и цвет с блеском тоже великолепные!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hahaha! If this works, it'll be long and flowing again...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Если сработает — снова будут длинными и струящимися...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Ah, nothing, nothing! Here you go, girls. Your reward.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ах, ничего, ничего! Вот, девочки. Ваша награда.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: What? This much? All we did was bring you some thread!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Что? Так много? Мы всего лишь принесли вам немного нитей!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: It's fine, don't worry about it! However...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Всё в порядке, не волнуйтесь! Однако...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Don't tell anyone else about this. Understand?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Никому больше об этом не говорите. Поняли?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Good. Everything is going according to plan!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hey, Sue... You guessed what Hagel is planning on making, right?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Эй, Сью... Ты догадалась, что Хагель собирается сделать, верно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Yeah. I've got a pretty good idea.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ага. У меня есть довольно ясная идея.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: But why now? I don't know how I'll react if he comes out wearing, well, you know...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Но почему сейчас? Не знаю, как другие отреагирую, если он выйдет в... ну, ты понимаешь...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hahaha! Let's just leave him to it, shall we?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Давай просто оставим его в покое, ладно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Yes, all ready. What about you?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Да, всё готово. А у тебя?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Good! Now we can proceed to the final stage!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Отлично! Теперь можно перейти к финальному этапу!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Excellent. I'm so looking forward to this!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Me too. Let's make a real splash!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: You said it! Like fireworks and gunpowder!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Ты сказал это! Как фейерверк и порох!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: What can we do, Sue? I think we just saw something pretty crazy!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Что нам делать, Сью? Кажется, мы только что увидели что-то совсем безумное!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Hagel and Pamela! The two of them together are more dangerous than a cauldron about to explode!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Хагель и Памела! Они вдвоём опаснее котла, который вот-вот взорвётся!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Lydie... Promise with Mom Number 7: "Sometimes pretend you didn't see anything".
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Лиди... Обещание маме номер семь: «Иногда делай вид, что ничего не видишь».

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Well said. We didn't see a thing. We don't know a thing. Nope! Nothing!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Хорошо сказано. Мы ничего не видели. Ничего не знаем. Неа! Ничего!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Come on, you rabble! Make some noise!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Onlookers
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Raaaah!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Hehehe! You over there, come and watch too!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Эй, вы там — тоже идите смотреть!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: What's this? Isn't that...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: H-Hagel and Pamela? What are they doing now?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Х-Хагель и Памела? Что они сейчас делают?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Come on! Are you having a good time?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Onlookers
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Yeah!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: If you aren't, I'll have to punish you!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Spectator
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: I want to be punished!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: What is this? Someone, please, I need an explanation!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Что это?! Кто-нибудь, объясните мне, пожалуйста!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Here comes our first song!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: We're going to sing with all our hearts! Listen with all of yours! This song is called...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Мы будем петь от всего сердца! Слушайте от всего сердца! Эта песня называется...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Together
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: "Ah, Burning Sister of Love!"

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: "Ah, Burning Sister of Love!"

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Nearby Resident
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: That was incredible! I'm so pumped!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Это было невероятно! Я так заведён!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: unknown(name_id=36)
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Yeah! When the big guy dived into the crowd, though, I thought I was going to get squashed!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Ага! Правда, когда здоровяк нырнул в толпу, я думал, меня раздавят!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Old Man
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Hohoho! I was hoping that young lady would take a stage dive!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Хо-хо-хо! Я надеялся, что эта юная леди тоже прыгнет со сцены!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: So this is what they were planning...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Yeah. A totally bizarre concert, right in front of the castle.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Ага. Совершенно безумный концерт прямо перед замком.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Even crazier than I imagined!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Those two really are something. But what that something is, I'm not quite sure...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Эти двое — просто нечто. Вот только что это за «нечто», я пока и сама не пойму...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: There comes a time, for a man and a woman~!<CR>When they simply cannot back down~!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Наступает время для мужчины и женщины~!<CR>Когда они просто не могут отступить~!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hahaha, Hagel is in a good mood.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, Хагель в хорошем настроении.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Because of that concert?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Из-за того концерта?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hey! You saw that, did you?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Эй! Вы это видели, да?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Yeah. It was all very unexpected, though. I wasn't sure what I was even seeing.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ага. Хотя всё было очень неожиданно. Я даже не уверена, что именно я увидела.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hahaha, glad to hear it! That was one hot performance!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, рад слышать! То было жаркое выступление!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I made all sorts of plans with Pamela, and I'm glad they all worked out!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Мы с Памелой столько всего задумали — и я рад, что всё сработало!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I'm just glad you didn't get arrested. Doing that right in front of the castle!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я просто рада, что вас не арестовали. Устроить такое прямо перед замком!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hahaha! I bet the king is a fan, too!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Держу пари, король тоже фанат!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: What do you think, girls? How about joining us up on the stage next time...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Что скажете, девочки? В следующий раз присоединитесь к нам на сцене...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Together
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: No thanks.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Нет, спасибо.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: No thanks.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Нет, спасибо.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Gah, you're no fun...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Эх, вы скучные...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: To tell you the truth, I did learn one thing from that performance.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Честно говоря, благодаря тому выступления я кое-чему научился.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Yes? What is it, Hagel? You look so serious, all of a sudden!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Да? Что такое, Хагель? Вы вдруг стали таким серьёзным!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Listen to this. At the end of the concert, I dived into the crowd.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Слушайте. В конце концерта я нырнул в толпу.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Unfortunately, by doing so, I totally busted my back!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: К сожалению, спину себе при этом совсем сорвал!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hah! Sounds like you got what you deserved...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха! Похоже, вы получили по заслугам...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: It was all sorts of fun, so I don't mind, but it wasn't all nice...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Было очень весело, так что я не жалею, но не всё было гладко...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I'm not a young man any more. I can't push myself so hard!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я уже не молод. Не могу так себя надрывать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I think that kind of foolishness should be avoided, regardless of your age!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: По-моему, таких глупостей стоит избегать в любом возрасте!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: So I have an idea! Before my body gives out, I want to forge the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Поэтому у меня идея! Пока тело не сдало, хочу выковать совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Huh...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: That's not much of a reaction! You know what I'm going to say next, right?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Слабая реакция! Вы же знаете, что я скажу дальше, да?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: What? We can leave?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Что? Мы можем уйти?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: You're joking! I want you to get me the materials using your alchemy!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Шутите! Хочу, чтобы вы добыли мне материалы своей алхимией!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I guessed as much... What kind of materials do you want, then?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я так и думала... Какие материалы вам нужны?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Right. It's a metal, and it's called Harnonian. Nope, Harmonican? Harminimum?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Так. Это металл, называется Гарнониан. Нет, Гармоникан? Гарминимум?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Anyway, it's really hard to make, even using alchemy. But I bet you two can do it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: В общем, его очень трудно сделать даже алхимией. Но держу пари, вы двое справитесь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Alright. If this is to make a weapon, I guess we can help you.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Хорошо. Если это для оружия — думаю, мы можем помочь.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Well said, girls! The most beautiful sisters in the city! I'm counting on you!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Вот это слова, девочки! Самые прекрасные сёстры в городе! Рассчитываю на вас!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Ah! Yes! This is Hagelnium!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Ах! Да! Это Хагельниум!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: You mean Harmonium.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Вы имеете в виду Гармониум.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: That's right, that's the stuff. Now I can make the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Верно, вот оно. Теперь я могу создать совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Right, let's get started at once! I need your help too, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Так, начнём сразу! Мне тоже нужна ваша помощь, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Lend me all of your knowledge as alchemists!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Одолжите мне все свои алхимические знания!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hahaha! We can't turn you down, Hagel!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Мы не можем вам отказать, Хагель!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: That's right! Let's combine our strengths and create the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Верно! Объединим силы и создадим совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Everyone
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: We did it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Мы сделали это!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: We did it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Мы сделали это!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: We did it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Мы сделали это!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: This is our weapon! A weapon among weapons, the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Это наше оружие! Оружие среди оружия — совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: I don't know much about weapons, but I can tell these are amazing!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Я мало смыслю в оружии, но видно — оно потрясающее!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Me too! We've made something really incredible, haven't we?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Я тоже! Мы сделали что-то и правда невероятное, да?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Of course! Made by the greatest blacksmith and the two future greatest alchemists!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Конечно! Сделано величайшим кузнецом и двумя будущими величайшими алхимиками!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: It's so amazing, the word "amazing" can't do it justice!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Так потрясающе, что слово «потрясающе» этого не передаёт!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hagel! You're right!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Хагель! Вы правы!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: You two girls, too, have really grown up. All your advice back there really helped me out.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Вы, девочки, тоже по-настоящему выросли. Все ваши советы тогда мне очень помогли.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Totally different from when you were blowing up your cauldron all the time! Gah, now my eyes are sweating!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Совсем не то, когда вы постоянно взрывали котёл! Ах, теперь глаза потеют!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hey, Hagel! No need to cry! Please, you're going to make us choke up!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Эй, Хагель! Не надо плакать! Пожалуйста, вы нас самих до слёз доведёте!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hey, one thing! Please, keep coming! Keep coming to my shop!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Эй, ещё одно! Пожалуйста, продолжайте приходить! Приходите в мой магазин!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: No matter how impressive you get, I'll make anything you might need! I promise!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Какими бы крутыми вы ни стали — сделаю всё, что вам понадобится! Обещаю!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Sure! We understand! We'll come! Well keep coming for sure!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Конечно! Понимаем! Придём! Обязательно будем приходить!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: So please, Hagel! Just stop crying!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Так что пожалуйста, Хагель! Просто перестаньте плакать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: <CLEG>Bloom Spiral<CLNR> and <CLEG>Star Suelle<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Получены <CLEG>Цветочная спираль<CLNR> и <CLEG>Звёздная Сюэль<CLNR>.
